description: Save a named set of conditions over the workspace's contacts. It stores no contacts: whoever matches the conditions when an action names the segment is in it. Names are unique in the workspace, case ignored: a taken one answers 409. A workspace keeps up to 100. A condition that doesn't fit its field answers 400 with its path; so does a label or campaign id that isn't this workspace's. Try the conditions first with count_segment_matches.

conditions.description: The tests a contact must pass, up to 20 in all. Each is {field, op} and, for the tests that compare with something, value or values. Fields, with the tests each takes: search (every word of value, each in the address, the name or the company (the Contacts search)): contains; email (the address): equals, not_equals, contains, not_contains, starts_with, ends_with; domain (the part of the address after the @): equals, not_equals, contains, not_contains, starts_with, ends_with; first_name (first name): equals, not_equals, contains, not_contains, starts_with, ends_with, is_empty, is_not_empty; last_name (last name): equals, not_equals, contains, not_contains, starts_with, ends_with, is_empty, is_not_empty; company (company): equals, not_equals, contains, not_contains, starts_with, ends_with, is_empty, is_not_empty; custom (the custom field named by key): equals, not_equals, contains, not_contains, starts_with, ends_with, is_empty, is_not_empty; subscribed (false once the person unsubscribed or the address was suppressed for good): is_true, is_false; suppressed (campaigns won't write to it now: the address or its domain is on the suppression list, or the person unsubscribed): is_true, is_false; check (where the address check stands, values from valid, risky, invalid, unknown, not_checked, checking, waiting, needs_retry, out_of_date (as count_contacts' check filter reads them)): in, not_in; label (carries a label, values are label ids): in, not_in, any, none; created_at (when the contact was added): before, after, in_last_days, not_in_last_days; updated_at (when the contact last changed): before, after, in_last_days, not_in_last_days; campaign (was added to a campaign as a lead, values are campaign ids): in, not_in, any, none; campaign_sent (a campaign's email was sent to them): in, not_in, any, none; campaign_replied (replied to a campaign themselves (an away message doesn't count)): in, not_in, any, none; campaign_bounced (a campaign's email to them bounced): in, not_in, any, none; campaign_opened (a person opened a campaign's email to them; scanners and mail proxies don't count. It needs open tracking on a verified tracking domain: with none in use, in and any match nobody, and not_in and none match everyone, people the campaign never emailed included (add campaign_sent to find people who got the email and didn't open)): in, not_in, any, none; campaign_clicked (a person followed a tracked link in a campaign's email to them; scanners don't count. It needs click tracking on a verified tracking domain: with none in use, in and any match nobody, and not_in and none match everyone, people the campaign never emailed included (add campaign_sent to find people who got the email and didn't click)): in, not_in, any, none. Text tests ignore case and take value, up to 200 characters. in and not_in take values, up to 200. any and none mean at least one, or none at all, of any label or campaign. before and after take value as a day, YYYY-MM-DD, on the workspace's calendar, the day itself not included. in_last_days and not_in_last_days take value as a whole number of days, 1 to 3650, counted back from now. is_empty, is_not_empty, is_true, is_false, any and none take no value. One level of groups: an entry {match, conditions} counts as one condition, so (A or B) and C is match all with [{match: any, conditions: [A, B]}, C]. A group inside a group is refused. A label or campaign id must be one of this workspace's.
The conditions inside this group. The whole group counts as one condition.

idempotencyKey.description: Your own id for this one call, such as a UUID, up to 255 characters. If the call fails with no answer, call again with the same key and the same arguments: within 24 hours, a saved answer comes back instead of a second run. A call left unanswered can run again after 15 minutes, so a send also keeps its intentKey or draft revision.
